content.title: Ibiza, Spain | Destination Travel Guide | Inspirato
content.text: / Destinations / Ibiza, Spain / Situated in a Mediterranean archipelago just off the coast of Spain, Ibiza is known for its lively nightlife, charming villages, wellness retreats, and beautiful beaches. Explore the quieter side of Ibiza with Inspirato at Nobu Ibiza, featuring its namesake restaurant, multiple pools, a Six Senses spa, and more. Spanish Island Life An iconic Spanish island in the Mediterranean, Ibiza is known for its lively nightlife scene and over 100 miles of coastline with beautiful beaches. Rich in history and culture, Ibiza’s famous Old Town, Dalt Vila, was named a UNSECO World Heritage Site in 1999. Stroll the cobbled streets within its fortified walls to get a feel for what life was like in the 16th century. The island is top notch for those seeking outdoor activity, too, from hiking along cliff tops to snorkeling in crystal-clear waters. Whether you’re attending one of the island’s famed music festivals or seeking a Mediterranean beach getaway, Ibiza is an ideal island retreat.
